note: P4152 (Pro 20:30) — blows that wound cleanse away evil; strokes make clean the innermost parts. (ra read as char.)

dims.v: purged evil — driven out by painful discipline
the evil that painful blows/wounds cleanse away, purging the innermost parts
the evil driven from the heart by the pain of correction

ra (evil) — 'blows that wound cleanse away EVIL; strokes make clean the innermost parts'; painful discipline purges evil from the heart. The read holds the hard truth — correction that wounds can cleanse the inner being. Pain as purgation (cf 3:11-12).
